season.source: https://onondagacountyparks.com/parks/oneida-shores-park/camping/ ('2027 Days of Operation: Weekends (Friday & Saturday nights only) Friday, April 23 - Sunday, May 23; Daily, Friday, May 28 - Sunday, October 10'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Online (Bonfire, 'RESERVE NOW') any time, or by phone Mon-Fri 8 am-4 pm, from January 1 for the season; no same-day online bookings. Changes or cancellations need 7 days' email notice to park staff, and one night's fee is non-refundable on every reservation. Permits for at most 14 cumulative nights.

booking.source: https://onondagacountyparks.com/parks/oneida-shores-park/camping/ ('Reservations Open January 1 for the season'; 'A minimum one night fee is non-refundable on all reservations') + Bonfire page data ('Online reservations can be made 24/7. Phone reservations can be made Monday - Friday from 8:00am-4:00pm', 'preventSameDay':true, 'Camping permits will not be issued for more than 14 cumulative nights'), read 2026-10-21

note: Onondaga County park on Oneida Lake/Muskrat Bay (Brewerton, near I-81). Beach/swim area; campground loop sits inland behind a tree band, not on the shore. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $35 for the 30-amp electric + water RV sites (the $25 basic sites are tents only), phone 315-676-7366, reservable. Corrected booking from phone to online (Bonfire) or phone; added 30-amp, 2027 season (weekends Apr 23 - May 23, daily May 28 - Oct 10), showers, dump, booking terms.
